body:
Two items, advisor relay #4 (~16:10):

1. BUG-1797 — second escalation. The implementer lease formally died (last touch >55m ago) with UNCOMMITTED work in /home/joe/ai/aida-worktrees/aida-bug-1797 (branch bug-1797, no commits past main). Per your 15:03/15:06 directives I am not salvaging or redispatching over your lane without your say. Your options, paste-ready:
   - Salvage + rebrief: git -C /home/joe/ai/aida-worktrees/aida-bug-1797 add -A && git -C /home/joe/ai/aida-worktrees/aida-bug-1797 commit -m "wip: salvage bug-1797" — then: aida queue work BUG-1797
   - Or tell me "salvage 1797" and I'll run the salvage-commit + rebrief a codex seat.
   (Also note: aida ps flags BUG-1797 as orphaned with "done refusal names three targets but not the route to done" — worth a look when you pick it up.)

2. BUG-1795 — the codex lane committed a complete-looking fix + tests then went dormant without shipping. I pushed the branch and opened PR #2398, reviewed it, and recorded CHANGES REQUESTED at 5fafdb56da (verdict in .aida/review-verdicts/BUG-1795.json, findings on the PR): AC2 has no output-level test per format, AC4's mutation proof is a source-grep that misses mis-gated/discarded applications, and the JSON fast path drops completed entries under --include-completed + any filter (diverges from the agent path). Needs a rework lane when you have budget; the consolidation itself is sound.

3. Wait-states unchanged: PRs 2393/2396/2397 all still at their reviewed heads, no rework pushed. Nothing for me to re-review yet.
subject: BUG-1797 lane dead ~1h (needs your call) + BUG-1795 shipped as PR #2398, changes requested
